rationale: Z has the most specific and convincing product UI (multitrack session with a timecoded edit log and a held legal claim), a distinctive italic-accent serif headline, and the richest page structure, including a Gantt-style process visual and a dark planning-call band. Y has a strong tilted mixer visual and a bold terracotta and navy palette, but the hero headline wraps awkwardly and the stamp and sticky-note details feel slightly overworked. X is clean and competent, but its single teal accent on cream, standard card grid and simple progress-card visual read as the most template-like.
